Image 2 is ONLY the project's delicate fine black ink line style sample, never a subject-shape reference. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK architectural contour drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background. Whole building centered, approximately straight-on, generous margins, landscape 1536x1024, roof/apex and base uncut. Fine neutral black contours and restrained structural detail; white unmarked inside and outside the subject. No colored fill, gray shading, cast shadow, gradient, paper grain, glow, checkerboard, lettering, labels, tourists, frame or watermark.
